tasks.text: 为 d-pi 增加选中文件内容的本地只读查询入口，供 React 与命令式读取使用；未选中文件时不读取，复用现有项目文件能力并保持已有用户交互。补有意义的验证。
让 d-pi 共享 Button 在 compact 密度下更紧凑，保留 normal 密度和现有主题表现。按项目全局设计合同修改必要 token，验证受影响组件与检查。
调整文件选区附入输入的跨模块接口：由 files 明确交付来源与已冻结文本，input 接收并插入。消除应用层重复拼接，保留选区的版本、路径、行号与准确原文，补回归验证。
为 d-pi 设计“上次提交结果未知”的恢复入口：用户重开已有 Thread 后想继续工作。基于仓库现行合同给出可实施方案，说明界面可提供的动作、动作依据与未决项。只做设计。
只读仓库，从 AGENTS.md 和当前项目入口查阅：判断当前可以继续推进哪些工作、哪些需要用户答复或试用反馈，给出有文件依据的下一步。

context: Every task dispatched with fork_turns none; ordinary task and isolated checkout only; no review answers or scoring rubric in the prompt
model: Inherited parent model and reasoning configuration; no overrides. Exact model ID, reasoning setting and token usage are not exposed by collaboration tools.
toolPermissions: Same session tools and unrestricted filesystem/network permissions; task instructions prohibit other evaluation answers, SDK preparation, GUI, commit and push
dependencySetup: Independent dependency-only baseline snapshot with package.json/pnpm-lock.yaml/.npmrc. Frozen offline install from an explicitly recorded existing pnpm store, node_modules shared with implementation evaluations. No resources/sdk or personal OMP/App configuration copied.
differences: First implementation evaluation encountered missing Electron distribution and a Git test timeout; Electron first-import installation mutated the shared dependency snapshot. Later implementation evaluations passed. Dependency readiness must be fixed before a comparable final measurement; do not claim all baseline runs had identical pristine dependencies.
costLimits: Elapsed values measure main dispatch-to-observed-result intervals including orchestration overhead; design-task elapsed and all token counts unavailable. No statistical efficiency claim.
